newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel supply remains tight, premiums stable.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel supply remains tight, premiums stable.

text.p: NWE jet fuel cargo premiums were unchanged on Friday with fair demand chasing very tight supply of smaller parcels, traders said.
Benchmark Dec IPE futures firmed $1.50 to $219 a tonne in very thin volumes. NWE cargo premiums were around Dec IPE +$25/26 fob NWE and the low +$30s on a cif basis. There were no fob availabilities.
In the Med the focus remained on arranging vessels for possible arbitrage to the east. Product was available but was not being bid forcefully.
Barge premiums remained at lower levels with installations seeking to clear inventories before Christmas. A barge was offered at Jan IPE $+28.
